service.en: Pay a visa or residence violation fine
service.ar: سداد غرامة مخالفة تأشيرة أو إقامة
service.ur: ویزا یا رہائش کی خلاف ورزی کا جرمانہ ادا کرنا

about: Pay fines for breaking UAE entry or residence rules, such as overstaying.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Pay a visa or residence violation fine. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to individuals, the private sector and the government sector
After paying, the status must be corrected or the person must leave the UAE
fees: Overstay or expired visa, residence, exit permit or newborn registration: 50 AED a day
timing: The page gives no processing time
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
